title: AHB INCR4 Address and Data Progression
description: A word-sized INCR4 burst starts with NONSEQ, advances through three SEQ addresses, and completes one data beat behind each address phase.

annotations.message: Beat 1 address phase: NONSEQ starts INCR4 at 0x20 with HSIZE=WORD, so the expected increment is four bytes.
Beat 2 address 0x24 overlaps Beat 1 data D0. SEQ proves this address continues the active burst.
Beat 3 advances to 0x28 while D1 completes for the previous address 0x24.
Beat 4 uses the final fixed-burst address 0x2C while D2 completes.
D3 completes Beat 4. The address phase is IDLE because INCR4 has no fifth beat.
